The '''Destruction of Aeten II''' took place in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], shortly following the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Martio Batch]] used the [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]] of the Empire's still-under-construction [[Tarkin (superweapon)|''Tarkin'']] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] to shatter the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Aeten II/Legends|Aeten II]], releasing million's of the planet's [[Stygium/Legends|stygium]] [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] into free-floating [[Realspace/Legends|space]], which Batch used to recreate the stygium screen [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]], technology that had all been lost to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
